name: mini-trello-root
description: Mini Trello - Full-Stack Kanban Task Management Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --pool=forks
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
